items.reason: The removal is real, but hasOneAdminRole checks client roles, not the realm-level ADMIN role (services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/MgmtPermissions.java:163-173). ADMIN already inherits the management client roles through composites (services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/managers/RealmManager.java:346-365), so administrators retain access. The remaining checks also match V1’s manage/view checks (services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/UserPermissions.java:234,298).
